name: Churchill
about: Bears gather near the coast Oct–Nov waiting for sea ice, and beluga whales fill the river Jul–Aug.
overview: "Polar Bear Capital of the World" — bears gather along Hudson Bay's coast waiting for sea ice, plus beluga whales, aurora, and genuine subarctic tundra.
costOverview: There's no cheap way to reach Churchill or to see its polar bears — flights are the only realistic option in or out, and even a single tundra buggy outing costs hundreds of dollars.

specialSeasons.text: Polar bears gather along the coast waiting for Hudson Bay to freeze — the peak bear-viewing window.
Thousands of beluga whales fill the Churchill River estuary, often approachable by kayak.
